name.value: Big Bay General Store & Post Office

description.value: Big Bay General Store & Post Office is a combined general store and post office serving the remote community of Big Bay on Stuart Island, British Columbia, accessible only by ferry. Founded in a region of dramatic coastal inlets, it is one of the very few commercial supply points on this isolated island. For touring cyclists venturing this far off the beaten path, it represents a rare opportunity to resupply in an otherwise extremely remote off-grid environment.

This is a false URL match between two similarly-named businesses in different provinces. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record represents a real general store and post office at Big Bay, Stuart Island, BC — a legitimate and useful resupply point for touring cyclists in a very remote area. No evidence of closure.
enrichment_extras.notes: Stuart Island's Big Bay is accessible only by water taxi or private boat; no vehicle ferry. The 'Post Office' component of the name suggests Canada Post services are co-located, which is common for remote BC communities.
